heading.title: Suits by or against the government or public officers in their official capacity

article.title: No security to be required from Government or a public officer in certain cases.
article.content:
8ANo security to be required from Government or a public officer in certain cases.

Order 27, Rule 8A
No such security as is mentioned in rules 5 and 6 of Order XLI shall be required from the Government or, where the Government has undertaken the defence of the suit, from any public officer sued in respect of an act alleged to be done by him in his official capacity. ,

3 Ins. by the A.O. 1937.
